message: Canny is customer feedback management and product roadmapping software that pulls feedback out of channels like Gong, Intercom and Slack into one place and merges duplicate requests. Verified product facts support this first-email scope: Start on Canny's Free plan ($0/mo billed yearly, 25 tracked users) and turn on Autopilot, included in all plans with no credit limit on Free, so it reads support conversations and sales calls from sources including Gong and Intercom, pulls out individual feature requests instead of whole-call links, merges detected duplicates, and triages them to the right team in one place. Draft this documented use. Treat recipient circumstances as unconfirmed.
